hed: Saturday in Branson: warm fall sunshine with highs near 87°F
deck: Saturday, October 10 brings warm fall weather to the lake with a high near 87°F, mostly sunny skies, and light winds. Perfect for outdoor shows, lake time, or exploring the Strip before the evening performances.

pick.title: Broadway to Buble
pick.why: Swing into the weekend with this high-energy tribute blending Broadway hits and Michael Bublé classics — a crowd favorite for first-timers.

shows.name: Absolutely Country, Definitely Gospel
shows.desc: Uplifting country and gospel to start the day. Warm, family-friendly, and soulful.

shows.name: Beach Boys California Dreamin'
shows.desc: Sunny surf-rock harmonies and classic Beach Boys hits. Ideal family matinee.

shows.name: Clay Cooper's Country Express Show

shows.name: #1 Hits of the 60s

shows.name: Hamners' Unbelievable Variety Show

shows.name: Hughes Music Show
